reserveReview.rationale: Re-review of the Accountable Noon deployment snapshot at data timestamp 1788026529156 (2026-08-29T18:02:09.156Z; total reserves $39,271,873.89; verifiability 100%). Raw deployment values are Private Credit (Fasanara FTAC) $24,667,649.67, US Treasury Bills $8,445,951.04, CLOs (JAAA) $1,800,175.38, Funding Rate Arb (HYPE) $1,584,299.43, DeFi Lending (Euler) $973,759.73, DeFi Lending (Morpho) $974,723.03, Undeployed $825,314.61, and Funding Rate Arb (BTC) $0.997. The current Accountable adapter normalizes positive values to one decimal: 62.8%, 21.5%, 4.6%, 4.0%, 2.5%, 2.5%, and 2.1%, respectively; the BTC balance is 0.0000025% and rounds to 0.0%, so the seven emitted rows sum to 100.0%. Noon's deployment-strategy documentation defines funding-rate arbitrage as a spot-long/perpetual-short delta-neutral cash-and-carry strategy, supporting the hedged-crypto classification of the HYPE-labeled row while leaving its venues, hedge notional, margin, and counterparties undisclosed. Noon documents Morpho and Euler as overcollateralized USDC/USDT lending strategies with protocol, oracle, liquidity, counterparty, and smart-contract risks; current vault addresses, pool weights, and borrowers are not published. Accountable's Undeployed label does not prove cash or stablecoin holdings, so that row is conservatively classified as other. FTAC, Treasury, and JAAA classifications are retained from the prior review.
